purchasing.title: Purchase orders
purchasing.lead: Order supplies from your suppliers by e-mail, then record what arrives into stock.
purchasing.form_lead: Choose a supplier, set the quantities you need, then send it by e-mail or save it as a draft.
purchasing.notes_ph: e.g. Please call before coming; we're open until 5 pm.
purchasing.notes_help: Included in the e-mail. Costs are never sent to the supplier.
purchasing.empty_text: Create an order for a supplier — low-stock items get a suggested quantity.
purchasing.low_done: {n} draft order(s) prepared, one per supplier. Review each one, then send it.
purchasing.low_none: Nothing to order: every low-stock item is already on an open order or has no suggested quantity.
purchasing.low_no_supplier: {n} low item(s) have no supplier — link them to a supplier or add them to an order by hand.
purchasing.low_already: {n} item(s) are already on an open order and were skipped.
purchasing.pick_text: Its items are listed with the current stock and a suggested quantity for anything that is running low.
purchasing.need_supplier: Add a supplier first — with an e-mail address so orders can be sent to them.
purchasing.and_portal: also shown in the supplier's {brand} account
purchasing.portal_only: E-mail isn't available, but this supplier is registered on {brand} and will see the order in its account.
purchasing.no_email_hint: This supplier has no e-mail address — save the order, then print it, copy it or share it on WhatsApp.
purchasing.mail_off_hint: E-mail isn't set up on this server — save the order, then print it, copy it or share it on WhatsApp.
purchasing.rule: Suggested quantity for items at or below their reorder level = twice the reorder level minus the current stock, and at least the reorder level (rounded up).
purchasing.no_supplier_items: No items are linked to this supplier
purchasing.no_supplier_items_text: Add any clinic item or a free-text line below, or link items to this supplier on the supplies page.
purchasing.more_lines_hint: Add any other clinic item, or type an item that you don't track in stock.
purchasing.summary_hint: Only lines with a quantity are included.
purchasing.need_lines: Enter a quantity for at least one item.
purchasing.draft_saved: Draft saved. You can send it whenever you're ready.
purchasing.saved_not_sent: The draft was saved but not sent.
purchasing.sent_mail_portal: Purchase order #{n} was e-mailed to {to} and is visible in the supplier's account.
purchasing.sent_portal: Purchase order #{n} was sent to the supplier's account (no e-mail).
purchasing.marked_sent: Purchase order #{n} is recorded as sent by the clinic.
purchasing.marked_sent_portal: Purchase order #{n} is recorded as sent and is visible in the supplier's account.
purchasing.resent: The order was e-mailed again to {to}.
purchasing.received_all: Everything has arrived — the order is complete and the stock was updated.
purchasing.received_part: Received quantities were added to stock. The rest is still awaited.
purchasing.delete_confirm: Delete this draft purchase order? This can't be undone.
purchasing.cancel_confirm: The supplier will be told by e-mail if it received the order by e-mail. Items already received stay in stock.
purchasing.not_sent_mail_off: E-mail isn't set up on this server, so nothing has been sent. Share the order yourself — copy the text, send it on WhatsApp or print it — then mark it as sent.
purchasing.not_sent_no_email: This supplier has no e-mail address, so nothing has been sent. Add one on the supplies page, or share the order yourself and mark it as sent.
purchasing.share_hint: Use these when the supplier prefers WhatsApp or paper, or when e-mail isn't available.
purchasing.mark_sent_hint: Only after you've shared the order yourself. It gets its number and waits for the items.
purchasing.mark_sent_confirm: Record this order as sent? Do this only after you have sent it to the supplier yourself (WhatsApp, phone or paper).
purchasing.receive_hint: Enter what arrived. Each quantity is added to stock as a "Received" movement noted PO #{n}. Leave 0 for anything still awaited.

txt.please_confirm: Please confirm this order and when the items will be ready. Thank you.

mail.title: Purchase order #{n} from {clinic}
mail.intro: Dear {supplier}, please supply the following items.
mail.please_confirm: Please confirm this order and when the items will be ready by replying to the contact person above.
mail.cancel_body: Please don't prepare the remaining items of this order. Thank you.

vendor.title: Purchase orders
vendor.lead: Orders that clinics sent you: the items and quantities they need, and who to contact.
vendor.pending_text: Clinics' purchase orders appear here once the platform approves your account.
vendor.empty_text: When a clinic that lists you as a supplier sends an order, it appears here and in your e-mail.
vendor.confirm_hint: {clinic} will be notified that you received the order.
vendor.note_ph: e.g. Available — we will bring it on Tuesday morning.
vendor.acknowledged: Order confirmed. The clinic has been notified.
vendor.note_saved: Your note was sent to the clinic.
vendor.cancelled_text: No need to prepare the remaining items.

errors_purchasing.PO_NOT_DRAFT: This order has already been sent, so it can no longer be edited.
errors_purchasing.PO_NOT_OPEN: This order isn't waiting for items any more.
errors_purchasing.PO_NOT_SENT: This order was already confirmed or closed.
errors_purchasing.PO_NO_EMAIL: This supplier has no e-mail address. Add one on the supplies page, or share the order yourself and mark it as sent.
errors_purchasing.MAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: E-mail isn't set up on this server, so nothing was sent. Copy the order, share it on WhatsApp or print it, then mark it as sent.
errors_purchasing.PO_MAIL_FAILED: The e-mail could not be sent. The order is still a draft — try again later or share it another way.
errors_purchasing.PO_NOTHING_RECEIVED: Enter the quantity that arrived for at least one item.
